subject: science
concept: Sorting objects by simple physical properties (color, size, shape, texture)
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student physically sorts a group of objects by a chosen property (e.g. all the rough ones)
exercise.pictorial: Student circles which pictured objects share the same property
exercise.abstract: Student states the property used to sort a set of already-grouped objects

misconception_flags: sorts by an inconsistent or changing property partway through

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
